purpose: Canonical Mission Control vocabulary, namespaces, collision policy, and compatibility aliases. Historical artifacts are not rewritten.

namespace_policy.principle: New machine identifiers MUST be unambiguous without relying on surrounding prose.

MC.rule: Bare MC is reserved for Mission Control in operational/control-plane identifiers.
MC.monte_carlo_rule: Monte Carlo MUST use MONTE_CARLO or MC_SIM in new machine identifiers.
MC.historical_rule: Historical bare MC is interpreted only from its source context and is never bulk-rewritten.

PR.collision_note: 3PR is a fixed method-profile token and is not parsed as three pull requests.
PR.precision_recall_rule: Statistical/ML precision-recall MUST use PRECISION_RECALL or PR_CURVE in new cross-domain machine identifiers.

3PC.collision_note: PC1, PC2, ... remain PCA principal components; 3PC is a method-profile token.

CONTROL.rule: Do not use bare CONTROL as a lifecycle state in new mission telemetry.

COV.rule: Bare COV-N is not canonical in new machine fields because software/code coverage also uses coverage terminology.

CODE_COVERAGE.rule: Never substitute MCOV maturity for code/test coverage percentage or vice versa.

PC1.rule: PCA component labels are numeric analysis outputs, not 3P method phases.

MCP.rule: Do not derive Mission Control Pulse/Process from MCP. Mission Control uses MC plus explicit object names.

P0_P1_P2_P3.rule: Pulse identity MUST use PULSE-<id> or a fully-qualified pulse identity; never infer a pulse from bare P1/P2/P3.

W###.rule: Bare W### is not globally unique. Cross-repository joins MUST use a fully-qualified wave identity.

PR<number>.rule: Bare PR number is not globally unique. Cross-repository joins MUST qualify repository.

MIP.rule: Within Mission Control method fields, MIP means Modernize-Innovate-Perpetuate. Mathematical optimization MUST use MIXED_INTEGER_PROGRAMMING, MILP where accurate, or MIP_OPT; bare MIP is forbidden for new cross-domain optimization identifiers.

CI.rule: New cross-domain machine identifiers MUST qualify CI. Use CI_PIPELINE/CONTINUOUS_INTEGRATION for DevOps and CONFIDENCE_INTERVAL/CI_STAT for statistical intervals.

GM.rule: Mathematical geometric mean MUST use GEOMETRIC_MEAN or GM_STAT in new cross-domain machine identifiers.

3PSTAR.rule: Three pulse checkpoints N+1/N+2/N+3, each requiring source-bound terminal evidence or an explicit BLOCKED partial return. Does NOT imply three merges, waves or green runs.
3PSTAR.collision_note: Distinct from historical 3PR, 3PC, 3P3 and priority labels P1/P2/P3.

3WSTAR.rule: Three work packages may overlap or contain multiple pulses. A work package counts only at its own work-barrier disposition and does not automatically advance N.

N3_CONTINUE.rule: Use 3PSTAR under the canonical mission owner. Do not imply autonomous background processing or approval to bypass independent admission.

G3P.rule: G3P is one wave containing 3 source/evidence-bound pulses at ordinal N+1,N+2,N+3. It is not three separate waves, 3PR, 3PC, three commits, three runner jobs, or three guaranteed successes.
G3P.identity_requirement: Each pulse uses owner/name::mission_id::W<label>::PULSE-<id>; bare P1/P2/P3 are priority values unless qualified.
G3P.safety: Missing or failed evidence does not permit acceptance, security waiver, authority transfer, or main merge.

3W.rule: Use only for three outcome-level waves; a wave may comprise many pulses and cannot be normalized to N+3 pulse progress.

3P-CONT.rule: Operational continuation count; distinct from 3PR/3PC/3P3 and 3P* selector, and never three guaranteed approvals or merges.

N3-AUTO.rule: Means no routine check-ins inside three bounded pulses; never overrides protected branches, owner leases, security, CI_PIPELINE or independent review.

MCOV-0.name: UNREGISTERED_OR_UNMEASURED
MCOV-0.criterion: No governed Mission Control coverage claim beyond discovery.

MCOV-1.name: IDENTITY_SCOPE_AUTHORITY
MCOV-1.criterion: Mission identity, scope/home, authority boundary, and source anchor are registered.

MCOV-2.name: STRUCTURAL_INVENTORY
MCOV-2.criterion: Work surfaces, dependencies, TODO classes, crew/resource needs, and relevant repositories/artifacts are structurally inventoried.

MCOV-3.name: SEMANTIC_DEPENDENCY
MCOV-3.criterion: Predicates, first-red/root families, dependencies, status/progress semantics, and evidence classes are semantically classified.

MCOV-4.name: EXECUTION_PROOF
MCOV-4.criterion: Relevant execution/proof paths have exact-source evidence and non-compensating outcome classification.

MCOV-5.name: LONGITUDINAL_CONTROL
MCOV-5.criterion: Regression/re-entry controls, distinct-source or later-repeat evidence where applicable, durable handover, and historical continuity are governed.
MCOV-5.does_not_mean: engineering acceptance, authority transfer, or automatic closure

core_terms.MISSION: Governed objective with its own identity, lifecycle, telemetry, authority boundary, and re-entry/closure conditions.
core_terms.SPRINT: Time/capacity-bounded planning and review envelope containing one or more waves.
core_terms.WAVE: Coordinated set of related pulses toward one bounded mission outcome.
core_terms.PULSE: One bounded observation, decision, or intervention against one predicate/first-red.
core_terms.RUN: Concrete machine or human execution instance under a pulse.
core_terms.CREW_MEMBER: Logical accountable role/agent assigned responsibility or analysis work.
core_terms.RUNNER: Execution substrate or habitat such as GitHub Actions, browser, Jupyter, local host, or external owner-operated environment.
core_terms.TODO: Governed action record with predicate, state, next legal transition, and ownership; not synonymous with mission lifecycle.
core_terms.PROGRESS: Measured fraction/count of an explicitly declared denominator; UNKNOWN when denominator is absent.
core_terms.HEALTH: Operational signal GREEN/AMBER/RED/GREY, separate from completion and authority.
core_terms.MIP: Modernize-Innovate-Perpetuate improvement family, admitted conditionally rather than automatically.
core_terms.DMAIC: Define-Measure-Analyze-Improve-Control supervisory improvement loop for Mission Control and suitable missions.
core_terms.REX: Return of experience / reusable learning and control feedback.
core_terms.DoV: Definition of Value/Verification as defined by the governing mission; never inferred from run success alone.
core_terms.BT: Bradley-Terry pairwise ranking diagnostic using real observed winner/loser pairs; not an alias for backtesting.
core_terms.PCA: Principal Component Analysis, a measured multivariate advisory diagnostic requiring comparable observed rows.
core_terms.SIPOC: Suppliers-Inputs-Process-Outputs-Customers flow model; governed feedback may seed a subsequent pulse.
core_terms.DAG: Directed Acyclic Graph of declared execution/evidence dependencies.
core_terms.KPI: Key Performance Indicator with explicit owner, denominator, time window, units and evidence status.
core_terms.3PSTAR: Three successive measured pulse checkpoints; 3P* is a human invocation alias, not a code token or proof of three green runs.
core_terms.3WSTAR: Three coordinated work packages (3W*); may be parallel, sequential or repeated inside pulses; not equal to N+3.
core_terms.PULSE_CHECKPOINT: Append-only source-bound terminal observation plus before/after metrics, blocker classification and next action; missing evidence is UNKNOWN.
core_terms.WAVE_ACCEPTANCE_BARRIER: Dependency/worker integration point where an orchestrated work package is source-verified; not a pulse checkpoint unless it independently satisfies pulse requirements.
core_terms.N3_CONTINUE: Bounded in-turn 3PSTAR command with baseline, goal, evidence contract, owners, limits, branch-scope, stop conditions and N+3 handover.
core_terms.MAJOR_BLOCKER: External or safety/governance constraint requiring a fail-closed stop for the affected pulse; return verified partial receipt rather than fabricate N+3.
core_terms.N3_RETURN_RECEIPT: Lossless append-only accounting of N, N+1, N+2, N+3 or blocked stage, with exact heads, native run/job identities, scoped metric deltas and outstanding controls.
core_terms.G3P: Governed Three-Pulse Wave: one bounded wave, exactly three ordered feedback pulses from a source-bound N baseline toward N+3; each pulse has an input, expected observation, actual evidence, disposition and next-source handoff.
core_terms.THREE_WAVES: Three distinct bounded WAVE work packages, each with its own objective, PR/source scope and independently sequenced pulse count; not a synonym for three pulses.
core_terms.N_PLUS_3: Three ordinal pulse transitions from N; denotes a traceable horizon/number of recorded dispositions, not three accepted source changes or a performance increase.
core_terms.HANDS_OFF_BOUNDED: Instruction to proceed without intermediate prompts inside one live bounded execution, respecting path leases, stop gates and authority; not permission for unlimited background execution.
core_terms.DISJOINT_WORKER: Scoped owner workstream with nonoverlapping changed file/path lease and independently identifiable evidence; worker or assignment is not a proven running agent.
core_terms.PREDICTION_ACTUAL_PAIR: Expected outcome frozen before each pulse action and later compared with source-bound actual; UNKNOWN when either side cannot be measured.
core_terms.THREE_WAVE_ADVANCEMENT: 3W: three coordinated outcome-level waves, each potentially containing multiple pulses; not equivalent to three execution steps.
core_terms.THREE_PULSE_CONTINUATION: 3P-CONT: exactly three consecutively evaluated bounded pulse transactions within a declared wave, N -> N+1 -> N+2 -> N+3; no skipped or backdated pulse.
core_terms.GOVERNED_N3_AUTO: N3-AUTO: run 3P-CONT without routine interaction, using explicit scope, exact source identity, approved actions and resource leases, independent gates and a stop-on-major-blocker policy. Does not grant blanket dispatch or merge authority.
core_terms.N3_START_ORDINAL: N is an integer pulse ordinal in a declared wave, not the number of repos, workers, commits, tests, or a global mission version.
core_terms.3W: CODEX global Three-Wave Delivery: three outcome-delivery packages. MissionControl local 3WSTAR remains source-contextual.
core_terms.3MP: CODEX global Three Measurement/Improvement Pulses: three source-bound feedback records; any HOLD does not confer accepted N increment.
core_terms.G3A: CODEX Governed Three-Advance Mission: target three distinct independently evidenced accepted gates; stop early at major blocker.
core_terms.ADVANCE: Evidence-qualified accepted checkpoint with owner/authority/required-gate confirmation; never inferred from a pulse, run, commit or PR merge.
core_terms.N_PULSE: Index of dispositioned measured pulse receipts; distinct from accepted engineering/mission checkpoint ordinal.
core_terms.N_ACCEPTED: Index of independently verified scoped acceptance checkpoints, which increases only when non-compensating requirements are satisfied.
core_terms.3PSTAR_COLLISION: Legacy MissionControl 3PSTAR displayed as 3P*, while method registry uses 3P* as a profile-family selector. New cross-repo identity MUST use 3MP/G3P and never bare 3P*.

alias_policy: Compatibility aliases are human/read-time mappings only. New persisted machine fields MUST use MCOV-N.

identity_grammar.rule: Never join, order, or aggregate cross-repository lineage on bare PR number, bare W###, or bare P1/P2/P3.
identity_grammar.g3p_pulses: owner/name::mission_id::W<label>::PULSE-1|PULSE-2|PULSE-3, scoped to one wave and bound to sequential evidence

BT.rule: Not backtesting. Compare observed winner/loser pairs; no observed comparisons means DEFER.

PCA.rule: Use observed comparable numeric rows; not acceptance authority.

SSOT.rule: Link to canonical owner; projection is not a competing SSOT.

p95.rule: Report sample population, window, unit and observed timestamps.

SHA.rule: Exact source identity; unqualified or stale SHA cannot support current-head admission.

AHT.rule: Expansion is context-qualified; CODEX AHT control and ABACUS statistics bridge are source owners. Do not expand to an unsupported universal phrase.

LDAB.rule: Diagnostic label from repo self-assessment; do not assert a separately authoritative LDAB release or undocumented expansion.

DOCKMASTER.rule: A zero-step startup/environment red routes here, not Doctor.

DOCTOR.rule: Activate only after observed application red with executed steps >0 and exact source binding.

FORECAST_BACKTEST.rule: Use distinct token; never alias bare BT to backtesting.

n3_continuation_extension.backward_compatibility: Historical 3PR, 3PC, 3P3, W### and pulse IDs retain original source context; no destructive renames.

definitions.pulse: Bounded source-bound evidence–decision–action–measurement cycle. Native terminal proof or explicit classified blocker required to disposition.
definitions.wave: Scope/owner-lease orchestration container. One wave may cover many pulses; multiple waves may serve one pulse.
definitions.checkpoint: Stable monotonic N+i measurement with exact source, typed denominator, native run attempt, observed UTC, owner, risk and return receipt.
definitions.n3: Three ordered checkpoint dispositions after baseline N, not three separate jobs, commits, PRs or automatic merges.
definitions.autonomous: Only within the active invocation and the charter's authorized bounds; no persistent unattended background agent is asserted.

n3_continuation_extension.cross_repo_resolution: For new cross-repository payloads use CODEX global 3W/3MP/G3A. MissionControl G3P and 3PSTAR remain scoped legacy/local; 3P* alone is ambiguous; do not recast historical sources.

actions: execute until each wave's independent outcome gate
run three bounded, sequential decision/action/proof cycles
return N+3 summary with receipts or first major blocker
run without routine prompting under explicit owner/path and risk scope
stop on major blocker or unauthorized material change
return planned/actual, receipts, tests, coverage, queue impact and remaining HOLD
N3-AUTO.does_not_mean: unlimited background agent; unattended protected merge

cross_repository_execution_units.purpose: Additive cross-repository interpretation. No second SSOT, authorization, release credit or historical rewrite.

ordinal_contract.n_pulse: Three evidence-qualified pulse dispositions may include HOLD/DEFER and do not imply N_accepted delta.
ordinal_contract.n_accepted: Only independently verified, scoped acceptance checkpoints increase this ordinal. Unknown or self-attested evidence never increments.
ordinal_contract.n3_continue: Invocation/target; not a proof of N+3, not an ongoing background agent.
ordinal_contract.g3a_target: Attempt N_accepted to N_accepted+3; return actual accepted ordinal and major blocker if fewer than three gates qualify.

namespace_conflict.3P*: HISTORICAL_CONTEXTUAL_ONLY: legacy method-profile selector or local 3PSTAR display alias. Never persist bare 3P* as cross-repository measurement unit; use 3MP or fully qualified G3P.

cross_repository_execution_units.source_scope_rule: Existing CODEX global taxonomy, MissionControl G3P local envelope and ABACUS G3A consumer remain separate; do not promote feature-branch merges or locally passed tests into guarded main acceptance.
